screens.penny: Hi, {name}! Money comes in more than one shape.

cards.caption: Coins are small, round and made of metal.
Notes are paper. One note is worth many coins.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! That's a note. Paper money.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Coins are round metal. The paper one is the note.
screens.retryIntro: Here it is again, {name}. Which one is the paper money?

screens.prompt: Put each picture in the right basket.
screens.pennyHint: Take your time, {name}. Drag a picture, or tap it and tap a basket.
screens.rightMessage: Nice sorting, {name}! That one belongs there.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Ask yourself: do we pay with it, or pay for it?
screens.doneMessage: All sorted, {name}! Coins and notes are money. The rest we buy.

screens.prompt: This note is worth 5 coins. Tap 5 coins to swap for it.
screens.rightMessage: 5 coins, {name}! That's the same money as the note.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! The note is worth 5 coins. Count them again.
screens.retryIntro: Let's count for that note again, {name}.

screens.prompt: Which is more money: one coin, or a full bag of coins?
screens.pennyHint: Look at how much is inside, {name}.
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! A full bag holds lots of coins. That's more money.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! The bag is full of coins. One coin is only one.
screens.retryIntro: Look again, {name}. Which one holds more?

screens.title: Nice work, {name}!
screens.message: Coins and notes are both money. You can spot them now.
